Name: Beach Day
Author: PatientAllison
Description:
Allows your farmer to wear the flip flops from the spa anywhere and provides a new set of swimsuits and pants for both in and out of the spa! This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5044]Get Glam[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]JSON Assets[/url]. Note that I have not tested every animation frame in game, only common ones (nothing story related), and have mostly tested with the female farmer. If you spot anything odd let me know!

In order to change into your flip flops, use the show option in Get Glam's menu.

Now features a full port of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/324?]Delta's Better Swimsuits[/url] mod to JSON Assets! (minus the Robe and Towel, which I am attempting to secure permission from LittleLea for) It's also been improved! All pants and swimsuits are now available for all genders! I tested all the swimsuits, some pants may look weird on the "wrong" gender as I did not test all of them. The pairing of which pants goes with which swimsuit has also changed, the list is below!

[list=1]
[*]﻿﻿Alt Skirt, Binder
[*]Apron Skirt, Bikini Top with Briefs
[*]﻿Ballroom Skirt, Bikini Top with Shorts
[*]Frilly Ballroom Skirt (will be paired with the towel if I can secure asset permission)
[*]Frilly Skirt, Wetsuit
[*]Haley Skirt, Briefs (this one is also topless for the female variant for inclusivity reasons)

[*]Just Shorts (both out of and in spa, this one is also topless for the female variant for inclusivity reasons)
[*]Long Skirt (will be paired with the towel if I can secure asset permission)

[*]Pleated Skirt, Bikini
[*]Pleated Skirt, Socks and Shorter Binder
[*]Skirt, One-Piece
[/list]
Note that I did not port the skimpier ones, as any nudity contained in this mod is out of inclusivity reasons, not sexual content.

New in 1.1:
An optional Content Patcher element that allows you to wear flip flops that match your shoes with the vanilla pants. If you have dye pants and are not using shoe coloring on your flip flops, it will not follow the dye, so don't install if you want to keep your dyed pants color.
8 different flip flop/swimsuit combinations! As they appear in Get Glam's menu:

0: Completely vanilla
1: Flip Flops everywhere, use shoe coloring, allows female characters to properly wear topless swimsuits and men to wear two piece swimsuits. (Modded)
2. Flip Flops everywhere, use shoe coloring, does not allow female characters to wear topless swimsuits or men to wear two piece swimsuits. (Modest)
3: Flip Flops everywhere, use pants coloring, Modded
4: Flip Flops everywhere, use pants coloring, Modest
5: Flip Flops only in the spa, use shoe coloring, Modded
6: Flip Flops only in the spa, use pants coloring, Modded
7: Flip Flops only in the spa, use shoe coloring, Modest

Note: For some reason the modest female options only work if the base is set to 1 in Get Glam's menu. This is a workaround and I cannot quite figure out the cause. I would generally only recommend setting it if that is what you wish as it actually causes issues in all other cases.

New in 1.2:

Since the release of this mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6101]Change Shoe Color[/url] came out, which is a much more elegant solution than having a dozen separate flip flop assets (also the thumbnails looked horrible anyway). As such, I have removed the flip flop recolors and that mod is now an optional dependency if you want to recolor your shoes.

While it doesn't directly affect this mod at all, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6326]Swim[/url] makes an excellent companion. It also allows you to wear your swimsuit anywhere you want, so I'm adding it as an optional dependency since a few people have asked for that feature, which I do not have the programming skills to implement into this mod.

Asset credits:
Flip Flops: Me!
[s]Sleeves (or lack thereof): [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3541]whutupribs[/url]﻿[/s] I am an idiot and did not realize there were already plenty of sleeveless shirts in the game already. As such, I have removed all Suns Out Guns Out assets.
Swimsuits: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/324]Delta9T
[/url]Fig Leaf and Bikini Bottom: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5029]simezi21[/url] (NSFW!)

Note that while I give permission to use my assets, I would love to still be contacted about any mods that use them!
